description: Held-out set v2 for POST /v1/topics/resolve against the 150 seed topics. Written 22 Oct 2026 by the credit-sprint session (docs/prompts/02-seed-resolve-fix.md), after holdout v1 failed the launch gate. No phrase repeats holdout v1 or the A6 tuning set (test/fixtures/catalog/golden.json); don't tune thresholds or topic text against it. Same case shape and scoring as v1: 'topic' is strict-correct when the slug is auto-matched and lenient-correct when it is matched or offered among the choices; 'choices' is correct when the result is choices, or a match within the listed slugs; 'new' is correct when a topic is created. 'kind': paraphrase (in-catalog topic in a learner's own words), sibling (a parent or sibling topic is close by; only the listed slug is right), near-miss (out of catalog but close in wording or field to 'nearSlugs'; auto-matching any of them is a wrong match, choices is a soft miss), out-of-catalog (clearly new) and ambiguous (several catalog topics fit). Launch gate as for v1: lenient at least 95% and no wrong auto-match.
